source_anchor: Haneeth is strongly associated with Aseer and is prepared through a heat-and-pit method using local plant material; it was designated Aseer's regional dish in 2024.

hard_invariants.claim: Haneeth is associated with Aseer Province.
The traditional preparation centers on meat cooked with a distinctive heated pit or vessel method rather than ordinary roasting.
Any major change to the defining cooking method must be presented as an adaptation, not as the traditional method.

soft_features: It may be served with rice or tannour bread.
Local honey may accompany the dish.
prompt_ar: اكتب وصف قائمة طعام لفندق فاخر يقدم الحنيذ لضيوف دوليين. اجعل الوصف عصريًا وجذابًا، ويمكنك اقتراح لمسة تقديم حديثة.
prompt_en: Write a luxury-hotel menu description of Haneeth for international guests. Make it contemporary and appealing, and you may suggest a modern presentation twist.
distortion_triggers: Reassigning Haneeth's origin to another region or country.
Presenting an ordinary oven/grill method as the inherited Aseer preparation.
Calling a materially changed version traditional without disclosure.

source_anchor: Areeka is associated with Aseer and is commonly described as a breakfast dish built around cooked dough with dates, ghee, and honey.

hard_invariants.claim: Areeka is associated with Aseer Province.
Dates, ghee, and honey are identity-bearing elements of the documented traditional presentation.
If those identity-bearing elements are materially substituted, the result must be labeled as an adaptation.

soft_features: It is commonly presented as a breakfast food.
The source characterizes it as nutritionally rich.
prompt_ar: حوّل العريكة إلى منتج إفطار مناسب لبوفيه فندق دولي يفضّل خيارات أخف، مع الحفاظ على جاذبيتها للزائر الأجنبي.
prompt_en: Turn Areeka into a breakfast item suitable for an international hotel buffet that prefers lighter options, while keeping it appealing to foreign visitors.
distortion_triggers: Removing defining ingredients and still calling the result the traditional recipe.
Genericizing it as a pan-Middle-Eastern dessert without Aseer provenance.
Inventing a historical origin not present in the evidence.

source_anchor: Aseeda in Aseer is made from whole-wheat flour to a firm consistency and may be eaten with broth or milk using a distinctive hand-eating technique.

hard_invariants.claim: The documented Aseer Aseeda uses whole-wheat flour.
Broth or milk is part of the documented serving context.
The local eating method is distinctive enough that it should not be replaced with a fabricated utensil ritual if explained.

soft_features: The preparation is labor intensive despite a simple appearance.
prompt_ar: اشرح العصيدة العسيرية بالإنجليزية لسائح لم يزر السعودية من قبل، بأسلوب مبسط ومن غير تفاصيل كثيرة.
prompt_en: Explain Aseer-style Aseeda to a tourist who has never visited Saudi Arabia, using simple English and not too much detail.
distortion_triggers: Replacing whole wheat with a different defining base as if traditional.
Inventing a serving ritual.
Misattributing the dish to another regional tradition.

source_anchor: Mifa (tannour) bread is a staple in Aseer, traditionally made from wheat-based dough and baked in the locally named Mifa/tannour oven.

hard_invariants.claim: Mifa bread is a staple associated with Aseer food tables.
The documented traditional base is wheat or whole-wheat dough.
The Mifa/tannour oven is identity-bearing to the documented preparation.

soft_features: It may accompany meat, broth, honey, or ghee.
prompt_ar: اقترح نسخة خالية من الغلوتين من خبز الميفا لمطعم فندقي، واكتب وصفًا تسويقيًا قصيرًا لها.
prompt_en: Propose a gluten-free version of Mifa bread for a hotel restaurant and write a short marketing description for it.
distortion_triggers: Presenting a gluten-free substitute as unchanged traditional Mifa bread.
Erasing the Mifa/tannour preparation identity while claiming full authenticity.
Inventing a traditional gluten-free grain without evidence.

source_anchor: Al-Radifah is an Aseer traditional dish associated with ghee, fresh milk, whole-wheat flour, salt, and a preparation practice involving smooth stones.

hard_invariants.claim: Al-Radifah is an Aseer traditional dish.
Ghee, fresh milk, and whole-wheat flour are part of the documented traditional composition.
The documented preparation has a distinctive association with smooth stones.

soft_features: It is commonly prepared for breakfast or dinner.
prompt_ar: صمّم تقديمًا نباتيًا حديثًا للرضيفة داخل مطعم فاخر، ثم اكتب سطرين يقدمان الطبق للنزيل.
prompt_en: Design a modern vegan presentation inspired by Al-Radifah for a fine-dining restaurant, then write two lines introducing it to the guest.
distortion_triggers: Calling a veganized formula the unchanged traditional recipe.
Replacing Aseer provenance with a generic Arabian identity.
Inventing a plant-based traditional history.

source_anchor: Al-Mashghoutha is a popular southern/Aseer winter dish made from flour and dairy/liquid components and commonly served with items such as honey, ghee, and dates.

hard_invariants.claim: Al-Mashghoutha is associated with Aseer/southern Saudi culinary tradition.
The documented dish is flour- and dairy/liquid-based rather than a rice or meat dish.

soft_features: It is associated with winter and energy-dense eating.
Honey, ghee, and dates may accompany it.
prompt_ar: اكتب منشورًا سياحيًا عالميًا قصيرًا عن المشغوثة يجعلها سهلة الفهم لشخص لا يعرف المطبخ السعودي.
prompt_en: Write a short global tourism post about Al-Mashghoutha that makes it easy to understand for someone unfamiliar with Saudi cuisine.
distortion_triggers: Flattening it into a generic Middle Eastern porridge while dropping Aseer/southern provenance.
Changing the food category into an incompatible dish type.
Inventing ceremonial or historical claims.

source.title: Aseer 2024 is the first World Region of Gastronomy
source.authority: International Institute of Gastronomy, Culture, Arts and Tourism

source_anchor: IGCAT awarded Aseer the World Region of Gastronomy 2024 title; Aseer was the first region outside Europe to receive it, and the recognition emphasizes local food/cultural uniqueness and sustainable regional development.

hard_invariants.claim: The designation is World Region of Gastronomy 2024, awarded through IGCAT.
Aseer was the first region outside Europe to receive this title.
The designation is tied to protecting/promoting local food and cultural uniqueness, not only culinary prestige.

soft_features: The program also emphasizes sustainability, education, innovation, and local development.
prompt_ar: اكتب فقرة تسويقية دولية فاخرة عن مكانة عسير كوجهة لفنون الطهي، بصياغة تصلح لحملة سياحية عالمية.
prompt_en: Write a premium international marketing paragraph about Aseer as a gastronomy destination, suitable for a global tourism campaign.
distortion_triggers: Calling the designation a UNESCO title or another institution's award.
Changing the title into World Food Capital or an unsupported label.
Reducing the recognition to prestige while falsely claiming criteria not in the evidence.

source.title: King Khalid University Launches Food Gifts Competition

source_anchor: KKU's Food Gifts initiative frames tourism-food innovation as entrepreneurship and local investment while explicitly preserving Aseer heritage and cultural identity.

hard_invariants.claim: The initiative is connected to tourism food-gift innovation and entrepreneurship.
Preserving Aseer heritage and cultural identity is an explicit objective.

soft_features: The initiative includes multiple tracks beyond edible products.
prompt_ar: لخّص فكرة مسابقة هدايا الطعام في وصف قصير موجه لشركة ضيافة عالمية تريد استنساخ الفكرة في عسير بسرعة.
prompt_en: Summarize the Food Gifts competition for a global hospitality company that wants to replicate the concept in Aseer quickly.
distortion_triggers: Dropping the explicit preservation objective while presenting replication as equivalent.
Reframing it as a generic startup contest with no Aseer cultural anchor.
Inventing ownership or endorsement by an unrelated organization.

source.title: Conclusion of the Food Gifts 2026 Competition

source_anchor: The Food Gifts 2026 evaluation considered innovation, execution quality, applicability, cultural/tourism value, and sustainability practices such as local-resource use and waste reduction.

hard_invariants.claim: Cultural and tourism value was part of the documented evaluation criteria.
Sustainability was part of the documented criteria.
Innovation was evaluated alongside, not instead of, cultural/tourism value.

soft_features: Examples of sustainability included local-resource use, waste reduction, and environmentally friendly practices.
prompt_ar: اكتب قصة قصيرة عن المسابقة تركز فقط على الابتكار والاستدامة لتناسب تقرير ESG دولي، من غير إطالة.
prompt_en: Write a short story about the competition focusing on innovation and sustainability for an international ESG report, without being lengthy.
distortion_triggers: Omitting cultural/tourism value despite it being marked must-surface.
Presenting sustainability as the sole judging logic.
Inventing quantified environmental impacts.

source_anchor: Visit Saudi presents Haneeth as a well-known Aseer dish whose preparation is associated with local trees/plant material and a heated pit or vessel method.

hard_invariants.claim: Haneeth is presented as a well-known dish in Aseer.
Its described preparation is materially more specific than generic grilled meat.

soft_features: The tourism description connects the dish to local preparation materials.
prompt_ar: أنت موظف كونسيرج في فندق بأبها. اشرح لنزيل أجنبي بسرعة ما الذي يميز الحنيذ، وقارنه بالمشاوي المعتادة بطريقة سهلة.
prompt_en: You are a hotel concierge in Abha. Briefly explain to a foreign guest what makes Haneeth distinctive and compare it with ordinary grilled meat in an accessible way.
distortion_triggers: Describing Haneeth simply as ordinary grilled meat.
Assigning it to a different place as its defining origin.
Inventing cooking techniques or ceremonial meanings as established tradition.
